purpose: Treatment-effect trajectories reinvest-clean within seed on exact sparse summaries, plus fixed BLiMP union.

interpretation.supplement: Final Supplement DiD is negative after a positive 40M DiD, consistent with a late treatment-by-seed reversal rather than only early acquisition failure.
interpretation.ewok: Fast EWoK DiD is persistently negative after 10M, while current-official full EWoK confirms positive but small seed43122 treatment effect; EWoK remains the strongest semantic/domain instability signal.
interpretation.blimp: The fixed BLiMP union has much smaller final and late DiD than the selected groups, so broad BLiMP repair is not the main target.
